questions.question: What does this sign instruct you to do?
questions.explanation: This is a stop sign: your vehicle has to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign forbid you from doing?
questions.explanation: The sign shows a horn (hooter) with a red line through it: you may not use your hooter.

questions.question: What does this sign forbid you from doing?

options.text: Driving your vehicle here between 06:30 to 09:00
Parking your vehicle in this area

questions.explanation: The motor vehicle prohibition sign has a plate below it with the times 06:30-09:00, so the prohibition applies during that period.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: There is a one-way roadway ahead

questions.explanation: This rectangular sign with a red background and a white arrow indicates a one-way roadway in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: There is a stop street ahead

questions.explanation: A blue circular sign with a white arrow pointing to the left means you must keep left.

questions.question: Which type of vehicles are allowed on this road?
questions.explanation: The blue sign with a motor vehicle symbol means the road is for motor vehicles only; it does not refer specifically to sedans or hatchbacks.

questions.question: What does this sign warn us of?

options.text: A dip in the road that is flooded

questions.explanation: The triangular warning sign shows a dip with water in it: there is a dip in the road ahead that may be flooded.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Motor vehicles are prohibited beyond this point
You cannot park in this area

questions.explanation: A motor vehicle symbol in a red circle with a red line through it means motor vehicles are prohibited beyond this point.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Bikes are prohibited in this area
Vehicles with an axle mass of more than 2 tons are prohibited

questions.explanation: The sign shows an axle with '2 t': vehicles with an axle mass of more than 2 tons may not go past the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All pedestrians have right of way
Don't stop your vehicle for pedestrians waiting to cross

questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped pedestrian priority sign means pedestrians have the right of way: stop and let them cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum speed limit is 50 km/h
The minimum speed limit is 50 km/h

questions.explanation: A blue circular sign with the speed in white is a minimum speed limit sign. A maximum speed limit sign has a red border, white background and black numbers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Only heavy motor vehicles are allowed here

questions.explanation: A blue circular sign with a bicycle (pedal cycle) means only bicycles may ride here.

questions.question: What does this sign prohibit truck drivers from doing?
questions.explanation: Two trucks in a red circle with a red line through one of them: truck drivers may not overtake.

questions.question: This is a...
questions.explanation: A capital S in a red circle with a red line through it means no stopping.

questions.question: Which of the following vehicles are prohibited in this area?
questions.explanation: The rear view of a truck with a diamond symbol refers to vehicles carrying hazardous substances; with the red line through it, they are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be aware of slow-moving heavy vehicles ahead

questions.explanation: This triangular warning sign warns of slow-moving heavy vehicles ahead, typically going down a slope.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you of?

options.text: It warns you of a tunnel ahead
It warns you of a car park ahead

questions.explanation: This triangular warning sign shows a tunnel ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are not allowed to drive below 100 km/h
You are not allowed to drive over 100 km/h at night

questions.explanation: The maximum speed limit sign with a night plate (stars and moon) below it means you may not drive faster than 100 km/h at night.

questions.question: What does this sign prohibit?
questions.explanation: The letters A and V stand for abnormal vehicles; with the red line through them, abnormal vehicles are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign prohibit?
questions.explanation: The arrow that goes forward and turns back is a U-turn; this sign prohibits U-turns.
